description: Show the menu for a merchant/restaurant by merchant_id (from a `search` result). The result includes the menu's `categories` (sections); pass a `categoryId` to browse that section's items (paged via `page`, with `has_more`). Omit both to show the top items; provide `query` to search within the menu. Renders as cards with category tabs and Prev/Next when the host supports MCP Apps. Results are paginated — a single response is only part of the menu. To locate a specific item, call this with `query="<item name>"`, which searches the entire menu across pages and sections (more reliable than paging for finding a named item).

categoryId.description: Menu section id (from the result's `categories`) to browse.

language.description: Result language: en, ar, kr, bd.

merchantId.description: Merchant id, e.g. from a `search` result's merchant_id.

query.description: Optional search term within this merchant; omit for the menu.

name: search_merchant_products

category_id.description: The section this page is showing.

has_more.description: Whether more pages exist for this section.

product_count.description: Number of products in this response.

title: Show a merchant's menu / products
